name: Kongsberg Gruppen ASA
summary: Kongsberg Gruppen ASA, together with its subsidiaries, provides high-tech systems and solutions primarily to customers in the defense markets. It operates through Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, Kongsberg Discovery, and Other segments. The Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace segment provides various systems and services to the defence industry.
